paper_title: ControlPULP: A RISC-V On-Chip Parallel Power Controller for Many-Core HPC Processors with FPGA-Based Hardware-In-The-Loop Power and Thermal Emulation
description: RISC-V怎样作为电源控制器：硬件在环并不等于真实负载芯片测能。用一颗管理RISC-V核加可并行的工作核集群，运行电源控制固件，并用FPGA连接模拟的多核功耗／热系统。
